title: No Start from the Block
story: Coach Rahman kept Leah in the slow lane after the six weeks the clinic had set. Her shoulder no longer woke her, and the catch that had ended her season was gone. She asked to rejoin the pace group on Thursday. Rahman refused, not because pain was obvious, but because the clinic note allowed endurance work and still prohibited racing starts. A start from the block would load the joint as the injury had. Leah said she felt ready and that the final was in a fortnight. Feeling ready, Rahman answered, was not the same as being cleared. He would add one length each session and review the note after two weeks. If the shoulder stayed quiet, he would ask the clinic to reconsider starts. Leah could still train, but she could not chase a place in the final. The limit frustrated her, and it kept a return from becoming a second injury.
